'''Christie''' (Japanese: '''リナ''' ''Rina'') is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] and a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW035|Where Did You Go, Audino?]]''. 

Christie helped [[Officer Jenny]] investigate the {{p|Audino}} disappearances after another Audino, with whom she was good friends, disappeared. She and [[Doyle]] would often argue on who would find the missing Audino first and would compete with one another using their {{t|Psychic}} Pokémon. She also had a hunch that the Audino were being manipulated by some sort of Psychic attack.

Christie would later be partnered up with {{an|Iris}} to watch after {{OBP|Mimi|BW035}}'s Audino, on which they had put a tracking device. The Audino soon started acting strange, so Christie and Iris began following it, only to meet up with Officer Jenny, {{an|Cilan}}, Doyle, and {{Ash}} again. Christie managed to slow one down with {{p|Gothita}}'s {{m|Telekinesis}}.

Christie and the others soon found all of the missing Audino and discovered that they were being controlled by sound waves created by {{TRT}}. She used Gothita to battle [[Jessie's Woobat]]. After the case was solved, Christie was eager to know if her Gothita helped out more than Doyle's {{p|Solosis}}. However, Officer Jenny informed the both of them that [[Ash's Roggenrola]] helped out the most, leaving them both disappointed.
